title: From Intraday Orderbook to Imbalance Price: Understanding Cross-Market Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2609.37903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power systems with increasing variable renewable generation face greater uncertainty in scheduling and balancing. Intraday and balancing electricity markets facilitate position adjustments and real-time balancing close to delivery. As delivery approaches, continuous intraday market participants exposed to imbalance settlement adjust their positions by trading additional volumes to reduce their imbalance exposure. We conjecture that positions remaining open after intraday trading, together with demand and supply uncertainties affecting physical market participants, influence price formation in the balancing market. This cross-market interaction is, however, rarely studied. To understand this interaction, this paper uses probabilistic modeling to examine how intraday orderbook information reflects subsequent imbalance price formation in Germany and Austria. translated_title: 从日内订单簿到不平衡价格：理解跨市场交互
translated_abstract: 随着波动性可再生能源发电比例的不断上升，电力系统在调度和平衡方面面临更大的不确定性。日内市场和平衡电力市场为临近交割时的头寸调整与实时平衡提供了便利。随着交割时间的临近，暴露于不平衡结算机制的连续日内市场参与者会通过交易额外的电量来调整头寸，以降低其不平衡风险敞口。我们推测，日内交易结束后仍未平仓的头寸，连同影响实体市场参与者的供需不确定性，会对平衡市场的价格形成产生影响。然而，这种跨市场交互机制鲜有研究。为了理解这一交互，本文采用概率建模方法，考察德国和奥地利的日内订单簿信息如何反映随后不平衡价格的形成。我们比较了基于开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价和成交量等多种订单簿表示方式……
tldr: 本文利用概率建模方法研究德国和奥地利日内订单簿信息如何反映随后的不平衡价格形成，揭示了日内市场与平衡市场之间鲜有研究的跨市场交互机制。
en_tdlr: This paper uses probabilistic modeling to examine how intraday orderbook information in Germany and Austria reflects subsequent imbalance price formation, shedding light on the rarely studied cross-market interaction between intraday and balancing electricity markets.
